title: CSI NEL — Next Line
summary: ESC E (NEL) moves the cursor to the beginning of the next line (carriage return + line feed). Equivalent to CR + LF.

terminator_detail.note: No string terminator: the CSI sequence ends at its final byte.

params.name: NEL
params.meaning: ESC E moves the cursor to column 1 of the next line.

gotchas: NEL is ESC E (a C1 control).
Equivalent to CR (0x0D) followed by LF (0x0A) / IND.
Respects the scroll region at the bottom margin.

v1_smoke_test.asserts: CSI sequence renders as a byte-exact sequence with final byte 'E'.
